correctness.rationale: For 30 unit vertices choose 15 antipodal representatives; K_k=P_k(dot) is real PSD and condition numbers are restricted to positive-definite degrees. The exact dot-product classes 0, (sqrt5−1)/4, 1/2, (sqrt5+1)/4 and rank-five zero-dot-product projection split K12 into multiplicities 1+4+5+5; the quadratic on the rank-ten complement gives min≈0.00284858 and max≈2.57695484, ratio≈904.6444977. The inspected h3_cert.py uses exact Q(sqrt5) recurrence, checks K12 projection identities, and performs 490 degree-by-degree integer Bareiss positive-definiteness certificates for 7,9,10,11,13 and 15..499. The source proof bounds k≥500 by a Legendre Laplace integral and Gershgorin, showing kappa<199; finite checks alone are not an all-k proof. Independent construction of 30 Cartesian vertices and SciPy P12 Gram for 15 representatives gives the claimed spectrum and kappa=904.64449771351. Boundaries k=0..14 rank are distinguished; k=14 remains singular.
